dialogues.jp: 「どうやら、遅刻せずに済んだようだ……」
dialogues.en: "Looks like this stops my latecoming streak..."
dialogues.text: "Looks like this stops my latecoming streak..."

dialogues.jp:
周りを見渡すと、まだ来ていないヤツもいる。
ほんの少しだけ早く来ただけだというのに、な
んとなく優越感を感じてしまうから不思議だ。
dialogues.en:
Looking around the classroom, I saw plenty of people still
not here. Being earlier made me feel a little superior
somehow.
dialogues.text:
Looking around the classroom, I saw plenty of people still
not here. Being earlier made me feel a little superior
somehow.

dialogues.jp: 杉並は……当然のようにいる。
dialogues.en: Suginami... is of course present.
dialogues.text: Suginami... is of course present.

dialogues.jp:
俺の視線の意図に気付いてか、余裕の笑みを浮
かべて見せるあたりがまた小憎らしい。
dialogues.en:
As I take a glance at him, he was wearing the same
ever-so-slightly annoying grin as always.
dialogues.text:
As I take a glance at him, he was wearing the same
ever-so-slightly annoying grin as always.

dialogues.jp:
工藤もいる。田端と一緒か。田端は相変わらず
頷いているだけだな。
dialogues.en:
Kudou's around, talking with Tahata. Reticient as ever,
answering all of Kudou's chatter with nods.
dialogues.text:
Kudou's around, talking with Tahata. Reticient as ever,
answering all of Kudou's chatter with nods.

dialogues.jp:
音夢は……風紀委員だけあってもちろんいる。
楽しそうに友達とおしゃべりをしている。
dialogues.en:
Nemu... being a disciplinary club member, of course she's
here. She's just happily gossiping with her friends.
dialogues.text:
Nemu... being a disciplinary club member, of course she's
here. She's just happily gossiping with her friends.

dialogues.jp:
眞子も、いつも通りちゃんと来てるな。あいつ
には一度遅刻の屈辱を味わわせてみたいものだ。
dialogues.en:
Mako's here, as usual. I bet she'd consider being late even
once as an eternal disgrace.
dialogues.text:
Mako's here, as usual. I bet she'd consider being late even
once as an eternal disgrace.

dialogues.jp:
林もいる。角田は……まだ来てないか。かわい
そうに、また遅刻確定か。
dialogues.en:
Shigeru's here. Kakuta... isn't here yet. Poor guy, he'd be
late for sure.
dialogues.text:
Shigeru's here. Kakuta... isn't here yet. Poor guy, he'd be
late for sure.

dialogues.jp: クマはちゃんと来ているようだな。よしよし。
dialogues.en: And a bear just came in, right on time.
dialogues.text: And a bear just came in, right on time.

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと待て、俺ッ！」
dialogues.en: "...Wait a minute!!"
dialogues.text: "...Wait a minute!!"

dialogues.jp:
がたんと、椅子を倒してしまいそうな勢いで立
ち上がる。
dialogues.en:
My chair fell back with a loud crash, as I hotly stand up
from my seating position.
dialogues.text:
My chair fell back with a loud crash, as I hotly stand up
from my seating position.

dialogues.jp: 「クッ、クッ、クマッ！？」
dialogues.en: "B, b, bear?!"
dialogues.text: "B, b, bear?!"

dialogues.jp:
俺は、斜め前の席に座っていたピンク色の奇妙
なヤツを指さす。
dialogues.en:
I pointed to the strange pink-coloured bear sitting at the
desk diagonal to me.
dialogues.text:
I pointed to the strange pink-coloured bear sitting at the
desk diagonal to me.

dialogues.jp: 「な、な、なんで、教室にクマが……」
dialogues.en: "W, w, why is a bear in class..."
dialogues.text: "W, w, why is a bear in class..."

dialogues.jp: わなわなと震える声で呟く。
dialogues.en: My voice was stuttering, barely audible.
dialogues.text: My voice was stuttering, barely audible.

dialogues.jp:
俺の視線の先には、ピンク色をしたクマの着ぐ
るみ──遊園地などでよく見るアレが、席に座っ
てなにやら本を読んでいた。
dialogues.en:
Right in front of my eyes, the pink bear-- something you'd
find more in an amusement park, was sitting calmly at it's
desk.
dialogues.text:
Right in front of my eyes, the pink bear-- something you'd
find more in an amusement park, was sitting calmly at it's
desk.

dialogues.jp: 自らの目を疑い、目をごしごしとこする。
dialogues.en: Not even believing my own eyes, I rub them rapidly.
dialogues.text: Not even believing my own eyes, I rub them rapidly.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「どうした朝倉よ。朝から、なにかコワイもの
　でも見たのか？」
dialogues.en:
"What's wrong, Asakura. Found something scary so early in
the morning?"
dialogues.text:
"What's wrong, Asakura. Found something scary so early in
the morning?"

dialogues.jp:
背後から、杉並の声がした。聞き慣れた声に、
非日常から日常へと、引き戻された気がした。
dialogues.en:
Suginami's voice from behind me snapped me out of my trance,
and finally brought some sense back into me.
dialogues.text:
Suginami's voice from behind me snapped me out of my trance,
and finally brought some sense back into me.

dialogues.jp: 「ん？　ああ。いや、なんでもない」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Ahh, nothing, nothing's wrong."
dialogues.text: "Hm? Ahh, nothing, nothing's wrong."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、杉並の方を向き、にこやかに答えた。さっ
きのは何かの見間違いに違いない。
dialogues.en:
I turn to face Suginami and answer him with a smile. What I
saw just now must've been a mistake, surely.
dialogues.text:
I turn to face Suginami and answer him with a smile. What I
saw just now must've been a mistake, surely.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうか？　ならいいのだが、顔色悪いぞ？」
dialogues.en: "Really? Your face doesn't look good."
dialogues.text: "Really? Your face doesn't look good."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、なんでもない。なんでもないさ。そう
　だ、ちょっとトイレに行って来る」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh, nothing's wrong, nothing at all. Right, I'd go to the
bathroom for a bit."
dialogues.text:
"Ahh, nothing's wrong, nothing at all. Right, I'd go to the
bathroom for a bit."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、杉並の方を向いたまま席を立つ。そして、
さきほどの幻覚を見た位置には目を向けないよ
うにして、入り口に向かう。
dialogues.en:
I headed for the exit of the classroom, making sure not to
look in the direction of the hallucination.
dialogues.text:
I headed for the exit of the classroom, making sure not to
look in the direction of the hallucination.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「トイレか。俺も付き合おう」
dialogues.en: "The toilet, huh. I'd go too."
dialogues.text: "The toilet, huh. I'd go too."

dialogues.jp:
杉並が、俺の肩をがっしと組み、朝っぱらから
暑苦しい光景を見せつける。
dialogues.en:
Suginami went beside me and rubbed his shoulder with mine,
making a rather unsightly scene for this early.
dialogues.text:
Suginami went beside me and rubbed his shoulder with mine,
making a rather unsightly scene for this early.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「たまにはこうして、仲を深め合うのもいいも
　のだな」
dialogues.en:
"Occasionally, it is a fine idea to deepen our
relationship."
dialogues.text:
"Occasionally, it is a fine idea to deepen our
relationship."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「気色の悪いことを言うなッ」
dialogues.en: "Don't say stupid things."
dialogues.text: "Don't say stupid things."

dialogues.jp:
やはりさっきのは、見間違いというか、幻覚と
いうか、きっと自分の気づかないところで、ひ
どく疲れていたに違いない。
dialogues.en:
That's right, what I saw just now must definitely have been
a mistake, a hallucination. I must be way too tired...
dialogues.text:
That's right, what I saw just now must definitely have been
a mistake, a hallucination. I must be way too tired...

dialogues.jp:
すっきりした後は、なぜか、心まですっきりし
たような気がする。
dialogues.en:
Steeling my mind on that idea-- no, truth, my heart felt a
lot lighter.
dialogues.text:
Steeling my mind on that idea-- no, truth, my heart felt a
lot lighter.

dialogues.jp:
これで、心おきなく今日一日を過ごすことがで
きるに違いない。
dialogues.en:
Surely my heart will be able to keep beating for the rest of
the day.
dialogues.text:
Surely my heart will be able to keep beating for the rest of
the day.

dialogues.jp: しかし、教室に帰ると。
dialogues.en: Except, when I went back to the classroom...
dialogues.text: Except, when I went back to the classroom...

dialogues.jp: 「…………なんでかなぁ」
dialogues.en: "......How can this..."
dialogues.text: "......How can this..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は人差し指と親指で、眉間をぐっとつまむ。
dialogues.en: I pinch my forehead, willing this to be a dream.
dialogues.text: I pinch my forehead, willing this to be a dream.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どうした？　教室にライオンでもいたのか？」
dialogues.en: "What happened? Is there a lion in the classroom?"
dialogues.text: "What happened? Is there a lion in the classroom?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いや、そういう訳ではないが……」
dialogues.en: "No, not exactly..."
dialogues.text: "No, not exactly..."

dialogues.jp: 俺の目には、まだあのクマが見えている。
dialogues.en: My eyes once again fell upon THAT bear.
dialogues.text: My eyes once again fell upon THAT bear.

dialogues.jp: 「杉並、一つだけ聞いていいか？」
dialogues.en: "Suginami, do you mind if I ask you something?"
dialogues.text: "Suginami, do you mind if I ask you something?"

dialogues.jp: 不思議そうにこくりと頷く杉並。
dialogues.en: Suginami, looking curious, nodded.
dialogues.text: Suginami, looking curious, nodded.

dialogues.jp: 「俺、やっぱり、疲れているように見える？」
dialogues.en: "Do I look tired to you?"
dialogues.text: "Do I look tired to you?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「特には見えないが……、疲れているのか？
　そうか、そうか。朝倉妹も大変だな」
dialogues.en:
"Not particularly... you're tired? I see, I see. Nemu must
be a monster, huh?"
dialogues.text:
"Not particularly... you're tired? I see, I see. Nemu must
be a monster, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「な　ん　の　は　な　し　だ」
dialogues.en: "...What...was...that."
dialogues.text: "...What...was...that."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「冗談だ。お前達はまだ若い。そんなに簡単に
　は疲れる訳はないよな」
dialogues.en:
"Just kidding. You're still young, you won't tire from that
so easily."
dialogues.text:
"Just kidding. You're still young, you won't tire from that
so easily."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「まだ言うか！」
dialogues.en: "Still talking that crap?!"
dialogues.text: "Still talking that crap?!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「冗談だと言っているだろう。だが、疲れてい
　るように見えないのは本当だ。何かあったの
　か？」
dialogues.en:
"I told you I was joking! Although truthfully, you don't
look tired at all to me. Did something happen?"
dialogues.text:
"I told you I was joking! Although truthfully, you don't
look tired at all to me. Did something happen?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……言うべきか、言わざるべきか」
dialogues.en: "...To tell, or not to tell."
dialogues.text: "...To tell, or not to tell."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どうした、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong, Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いや、俺は今ある出来事に直面している。し
　かし、それがとても現実的ではないため、信
　じてもらえるかどうか……」
dialogues.en:
"Nevermind... what I'm seeing now is too crazy for anyone to
believe..."
dialogues.text:
"Nevermind... what I'm seeing now is too crazy for anyone to
believe..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「何を言っている？　俺を誰だと思っているん
　だ？　それがどんなできごとであれ、頭ごな
　しに否定することなどしない」
dialogues.en:
"What are you talking about? Do you remember who you're
talking to? No matter how unbelievable the matter is, I'd
believe it!"
dialogues.text:
"What are you talking about? Do you remember who you're
talking to? No matter how unbelievable the matter is, I'd
believe it!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「本当か？　信じていいのか？」
dialogues.en: "Really? You'd believe me?"
dialogues.text: "Really? You'd believe me?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ああ。たとえ、幻聴を聞くだの、幻覚を見る
　だの言われても、俺はきちんと話を聞くぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Of course! Even if you've heard something or seen something
amazing, no matter what it is, I'd listen to you."
dialogues.text:
"Of course! Even if you've heard something or seen something
amazing, no matter what it is, I'd listen to you."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「教室の中を宇宙人が侵略していると言われて
　も、動揺はしない」
dialogues.en:
"Even if you told me that aliens were overrunning this
classroom, I will not be fazed!"
dialogues.text:
"Even if you told me that aliens were overrunning this
classroom, I will not be fazed!"

dialogues.jp:
さすがミス研だ。こういう時は、杉並が頼もし
く見える。きっと、俺の悩みもきちんと聞いて
くれるに違いない。
dialogues.en:
Thank goodness... at least in these times, Suginami's a
reliable person. He'd surely listen and understand my
hallucinations.
dialogues.text:
Thank goodness... at least in these times, Suginami's a
reliable person. He'd surely listen and understand my
hallucinations.

dialogues.jp:
「実はな……教室の中に、クマの着ぐるみを着
　たヤツがいるんだよ……！」
dialogues.en:
"The truth is... there's a bear in the classroom right
now...!"
dialogues.text:
"The truth is... there's a bear in the classroom right
now...!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「…………貴様は何を言うとるんだ」
dialogues.en: "...What the hell are you talking about."
dialogues.text: "...What the hell are you talking about."

dialogues.jp: 杉並が軽蔑した目で俺を見る。
dialogues.en: Suginami glared at me with scorn in his eyes.
dialogues.text: Suginami glared at me with scorn in his eyes.

dialogues.jp:
「お前、さっききちんと話を聞くって言っただ
　ろ！！」
dialogues.en:
"You just said you'd surely understand and believe my
words!!"
dialogues.text:
"You just said you'd surely understand and believe my
words!!"

dialogues.jp: ぽんと、俺の肩に手が置かれる。
dialogues.en: He patted my shoulder pitifully.
dialogues.text: He patted my shoulder pitifully.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉妹を悲しませることだけは、するんじゃ
　ないぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Younger sister Asakura will certainly be sad to hear
this..."
dialogues.text:
"Younger sister Asakura will certainly be sad to hear
this..."

dialogues.jp:
杉並は、深いため息をつくと、俺の目の前を横
切り、教室の中へ入っていった。
dialogues.en:
Suginami looked at me one last time, sighed deeply, then
returned to his desk.
dialogues.text:
Suginami looked at me one last time, sighed deeply, then
returned to his desk.

dialogues.jp:
目を閉じ、またゴシゴシとやる。目を開けた時、
俺の知っているいつもの風景が待っていること
を願って。
dialogues.en:
I close my eyes and rub them again. As I open them, I pray
that the usual scene I know will return to my view.
dialogues.text:
I close my eyes and rub them again. As I open them, I pray
that the usual scene I know will return to my view.

dialogues.jp: だが、｛・・／現実｝はそう甘くはなかった。
dialogues.en: But, reality is never that sweet.
dialogues.text: But, reality is never that sweet.

dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり、いるよな」
dialogues.en: "It really is there..."
dialogues.text: "It really is there..."

dialogues.jp:
ピンク色のクマがウチの制服を着て、ＨＲ前の
時間をごく当たり前のように過ごしていた。
dialogues.en:
As I continue staring at the pink bear and it's school
uniform, I realize that it's almost time for HR.
dialogues.text:
As I continue staring at the pink bear and it's school
uniform, I realize that it's almost time for HR.

dialogues.jp: 仕方なく、俺は自分の席に座る。
dialogues.en: With no other choice, I return to my desk.
dialogues.text: With no other choice, I return to my desk.

dialogues.jp:
今、俺は、自分のことを胸を張って正常だ！
とは言いにくくなっている。
dialogues.en:
Right now, I have to believe in what I feel in my heart!
...I try to tell myself, anyway.
dialogues.text:
Right now, I have to believe in what I feel in my heart!
...I try to tell myself, anyway.

dialogues.jp:
だが、しかし、正常であると思いたい。いや、
正常だ。
dialogues.en:
But, really, this does seem to be reality... no, it is
reality.
dialogues.text:
But, really, this does seem to be reality... no, it is
reality.

dialogues.jp: なら、この状況は……。
dialogues.en: Then, how to explain this situation...
dialogues.text: Then, how to explain this situation...

dialogues.jp: もしかして、今日からコスプレデー？
dialogues.en: Maybe today is cosplay day?
dialogues.text: Maybe today is cosplay day?

dialogues.jp:
誰だかわからないけれど、アイツはクマの格好
で、他の連中も実は、何かのコスプレをする予
定ってのはどうだ？
dialogues.en:
No one else seems to be bothered by it, and it's definitely
in the shape of a bear... maybe there was some cosplay
arrangement?
dialogues.text:
No one else seems to be bothered by it, and it's definitely
in the shape of a bear... maybe there was some cosplay
arrangement?

dialogues.jp:
じゃあ、ここは俺が率先して、コスプレをしな
ければなるまい。
dialogues.en:
Then I might as well take the iniatiative and participate
too.
dialogues.text:
Then I might as well take the iniatiative and participate
too.

dialogues.jp:
そうすれば、恥ずかしがっているみんなも、徐々
に参加してくれるに違いない。
dialogues.en:
I bet everyone else is too shy to unless someone else does
first, so I'd start the chain reaction.
dialogues.text:
I bet everyone else is too shy to unless someone else does
first, so I'd start the chain reaction.

dialogues.jp: 「確か、鞄の中に手袋があったな」
dialogues.en: "I think I have a glove in my bag..."
dialogues.text: "I think I have a glove in my bag..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、手袋を裏返し、頭の上にふたつ立てる。
dialogues.en: I turn the glove inside out, and place it on my head.
dialogues.text: I turn the glove inside out, and place it on my head.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、お前何やってんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura, what on earth are you doing?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura, what on earth are you doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「え、俺は……ウサチャンってところ？　さし
　ずめ、お前は、サルってところか？」
dialogues.en:
"Eh, I'm being a rabbit? What about you, being a monkey I
suppose?"
dialogues.text:
"Eh, I'm being a rabbit? What about you, being a monkey I
suppose?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「誰がサルだ……」
dialogues.en: "I wonder who's the real monkey here..."
dialogues.text: "I wonder who's the real monkey here..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「クマがいて、ウサギがいて、サル、イヌ、ネ
　コ……」
dialogues.en:
"We have a bear and a rabbit, now we need a monkey, dog, and
cat..."
dialogues.text:
"We have a bear and a rabbit, now we need a monkey, dog, and
cat..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「いまいち、朝倉の意図がわからないんだが
　……」
dialogues.en: "I don't know, and I don't think I want to ask."
dialogues.text: "I don't know, and I don't think I want to ask."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、あそこにクマの着ぐるみを着たヤツが
　いるだろ？　だから、俺はウサギの格好をし、
　工藤はサルでさ……」
dialogues.en:
"Don't you see the bear sitting over there? So I'd be the
rabbit, you'd be the bear..."
dialogues.text:
"Don't you see the bear sitting over there? So I'd be the
rabbit, you'd be the bear..."

dialogues.jp: 俺はクマのいる方を指さしてみる。
dialogues.en: I point to where the bear was sitting.
dialogues.text: I point to where the bear was sitting.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「病院行くなら、先生に言っておいてやるぞ」
dialogues.en:
"...You should tell the teacher that you need to go to the
nurse's office."
dialogues.text:
"...You should tell the teacher that you need to go to the
nurse's office."

dialogues.jp:
工藤は、｛ぶべつ／侮蔑｝の目で俺に｛いちべつ／一瞥｝くれると、逃げる
ように離れていった。
dialogues.en:
Kudou gave me a withering look, then went back to his seat
away from me.
dialogues.text:
Kudou gave me a withering look, then went back to his seat
away from me.

dialogues.jp: やっぱり、俺がヘンなのか？　俺が異常なのか？
dialogues.en:
Maybe... I'm the weird one? I'm the one who's acting
strange?
dialogues.text:
Maybe... I'm the weird one? I'm the one who's acting
strange?

dialogues.jp: ぎゅむーっと頬をつねってみる。
dialogues.en: I gave myself a tight slap on the cheek.
dialogues.text: I gave myself a tight slap on the cheek.

dialogues.jp: 「あいてててて！」
dialogues.en: "Owwww!"
dialogues.text: "Owwww!"

dialogues.jp:
俺は、正常だ。それを確かめなくては。どうし
たら、それを確かめることができる。
dialogues.en:
I have to be fine... yet everyone else doesn't see it. How
can I prove what I'm seeing isn't fake?
dialogues.text:
I have to be fine... yet everyone else doesn't see it. How
can I prove what I'm seeing isn't fake?

dialogues.jp:
つまり、あのクマを調べれば、全てがわかるは
ずだ……。
dialogues.en:
Maybe if I investigate that bear, everything will be
revealed...
dialogues.text:
Maybe if I investigate that bear, everything will be
revealed...

dialogues.jp: 俺は意を決して、腰を上げる。
dialogues.en: Making up my mind, I rise from my seat.
dialogues.text: Making up my mind, I rise from my seat.

dialogues.jp: 「おい、クマ！　そこの……クマ！」
dialogues.en: "Hey, bear! The bear over...there!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, bear! The bear over...there!"

dialogues.jp:
違和感のある言葉に、若干｛ちゅうちょ／躊躇｝しながらも、口
にする。
dialogues.en: My words were filled with both uncertainty and malice.
dialogues.text: My words were filled with both uncertainty and malice.

dialogues.jp:
ピンク色のクマは、一瞬ぎょっとして、キョロ
キョロと辺りを見渡す。そして、不思議そうに
首を傾げると、また、本を読み始めた。
dialogues.en:
The pink bear was startled for a second, then started
looking around. Finding nothing, it eventually returned to
reading.
dialogues.text:
The pink bear was startled for a second, then started
looking around. Finding nothing, it eventually returned to
reading.

dialogues.jp: 「お前、お前だっつーの！」
dialogues.en: "I'm talking about you! YOU!"
dialogues.text: "I'm talking about you! YOU!"

dialogues.jp:
俺は、クマのもとにかけより、でかい頭をぐい
と指でついた。指は、ピンク色のファーにずぶ
りとめり込んだ。
dialogues.en:
I rushed up to the back of the bear, and jabbed my finger
into it's head. The pink coloured fur enveloped my thrusted
finger.
dialogues.text:
I rushed up to the back of the bear, and jabbed my finger
into it's head. The pink coloured fur enveloped my thrusted
finger.

dialogues.jp:
振り返ったクマは、ふるふると｛おび／怯｝えた目で俺の
方を見る。
dialogues.en:
The bear frantically turned it's head to face me, with fear
in it's eyes.
dialogues.text:
The bear frantically turned it's head to face me, with fear
in it's eyes.

dialogues.jp:
「なんなんだ、お前は！　なんでクマの格好を
　しているんだよ。ほら、背中にチャックがあ
　るんだろ？　中に人が入ってるんだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"Why're you wearing a bear costume in school?! It is a
costume, right?! There's a zipper at the back, and there's a
human inside, right?"!!"
dialogues.text:
"Why're you wearing a bear costume in school?! It is a
costume, right?! There's a zipper at the back, and there's a
human inside, right?"!!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は、クマの肩にガッシと手を置く。
dialogues.en: I grabbed the bear by it's shoulders.
dialogues.text: I grabbed the bear by it's shoulders.

dialogues.jp: クマが思わず身体をよじる。
dialogues.en:
The bear reactively started twisting it's body around,
attempting to escape.
dialogues.text:
The bear reactively started twisting it's body around,
attempting to escape.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと、朝倉！　あんた紫さんになにして
　んのよ！」
dialogues.en:
"Stop it, Asakura! What are you trying to do with
Murasaki-san?!"
dialogues.text:
"Stop it, Asakura! What are you trying to do with
Murasaki-san?!"

dialogues.jp: 瞬間、どんっと眞子が俺を突き放す。
dialogues.en: In an instant, Mako had pushed me away from the bear.
dialogues.text: In an instant, Mako had pushed me away from the bear.

dialogues.jp: 「む、むらさき？　いや、クマが……」
dialogues.en: "Mu, Murasaki? No, that's a bear..."
dialogues.text: "Mu, Murasaki? No, that's a bear..."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「クマが、じゃないでしょう！　なんで朝から
　同級生を襲ってるのよ！」
dialogues.en:
"What bear? More importantly, why the hell are you attacking
your classmate?"
dialogues.text:
"What bear? More importantly, why the hell are you attacking
your classmate?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ど、どうきゅうせい？」
dialogues.en: "C, classmate?"
dialogues.text: "C, classmate?"

dialogues.jp:
眞子が、きつい目で俺を｛にら／睨｝みながらこくりと頷
く。
dialogues.en:
Mako scowled at me, as the rest of the class nodded in
agreement.
dialogues.text:
Mako scowled at me, as the rest of the class nodded in
agreement.

dialogues.jp:
後ろにいた杉並を見ると、やつはまるで汚物で
も見るような目で俺を見ていた。
dialogues.en:
Glancing around, my eyes fell on Suginami, who was glaring
at me in disgust.
dialogues.text:
Glancing around, my eyes fell on Suginami, who was glaring
at me in disgust.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さん……、朝からいったい何を酔狂な真似
　をしているんですか。兄さんのやろうとした
　ことは、犯罪ですよ？」
dialogues.en:
"Brother...... what kind of vulgar activities are you trying
to do this morning? Are you trying to be a criminal?"
dialogues.text:
"Brother...... what kind of vulgar activities are you trying
to do this morning? Are you trying to be a criminal?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、そうじゃなくて、クマが……」
dialogues.en: "No, I'm not, the bear was..."
dialogues.text: "No, I'm not, the bear was..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「クマって何？　……ごめんなさい、紫さん。
　兄が朝からヘンなことしてしまって……。い
　え、謝って済む問題かどうか……」
dialogues.en:
"What do you mean, bear? .......I'm sorry, Murasaki-san. My
brother's really weird this morning for some reason..."
dialogues.text:
"What do you mean, bear? .......I'm sorry, Murasaki-san. My
brother's really weird this morning for some reason..."

dialogues.speaker: Bear?
dialogues.jp:
「あや……、だいじょぶです。私はなんともな
　いです」
dialogues.en: "Aya... it's okay, I'm fine..."
dialogues.text: "Aya... it's okay, I'm fine..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、兄さんも謝りなさい」
dialogues.en: "Come on brother, apologize as well."
dialogues.text: "Come on brother, apologize as well."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「謝れって……、このクマに？」
dialogues.en: "Apologize... to this bear?"
dialogues.text: "Apologize... to this bear?"

dialogues.jp:
眼前には、無垢な顔をした着ぐるみのクマがい
る。プラスチックでできていそうな目で、俺の
方をじーっと見ている。
dialogues.en:
In front of me was the pure face of a bear, it's plastic
eyes burning into my soul.
dialogues.text:
In front of me was the pure face of a bear, it's plastic
eyes burning into my soul.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「まだ言ってるんですか！　どこをどう見たら、
　紫さんがクマに見えるって言うんです！」
dialogues.en:
"You're still going on about that?! Whatever you're seeing,
stop calling Murasaki-san a bear!"
dialogues.text:
"You're still going on about that?! Whatever you're seeing,
stop calling Murasaki-san a bear!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だって、どう見てもクマが……」
dialogues.en: "But, I really do see her as a bear..."
dialogues.text: "But, I really do see her as a bear..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さんは、紫さんがクマに見えるから、襲お
　うとしたって言うんですか？」
dialogues.en:
"So you're saying that you attacked her because you saw her
as a bear?"
dialogues.text:
"So you're saying that you attacked her because you saw her
as a bear?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「襲ったんじゃない！　服を脱がして、中を見
　てやろうと思っただけだ！」
dialogues.en:
"It wasn't an attack! I just wanted to remove her outfit to
see what was inside!"
dialogues.text:
"It wasn't an attack! I just wanted to remove her outfit to
see what was inside!"

dialogues.jp: 音夢のショックな顔が見える。
dialogues.en: Nemu recoiled in shock.
dialogues.text: Nemu recoiled in shock.

dialogues.jp:
俺の行動はともかく、発言自体はヒジョーにマ
ズイものだったと口にした後、気がついた。
dialogues.en:
Once again, I said something incredibly stupid before I
thought about it.
dialogues.text:
Once again, I said something incredibly stupid before I
thought about it.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さん……。せめて、人間としての尊厳だけ
　は、捨てないでください……」
dialogues.en:
"Brother... at the very least, don't throw away what
remaining shreds of dignity you have left..."
dialogues.text:
"Brother... at the very least, don't throw away what
remaining shreds of dignity you have left..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、俺は……」

と言いかけて、続けるのをやめた。やはり、ク
マが見えているのは、俺だけのようだ。
dialogues.en:
I tried to explain myself, but cut myself short. I'm really
the only one who sees that bear...
dialogues.text:
I tried to explain myself, but cut myself short. I'm really
the only one who sees that bear...

dialogues.jp:
クラスの連中は、ほとんどの連中が、俺を哀れ
むか侮蔑するような目で見ている。
dialogues.en:
Everyone around me was staring at me with pitiful contempt
in their eyes.
dialogues.text:
Everyone around me was staring at me with pitiful contempt
in their eyes.

dialogues.jp: 当のクマも、俺を切なげな目で見つめている。
dialogues.en: Even the bear itself was staring at me accusingly.
dialogues.text: Even the bear itself was staring at me accusingly.

dialogues.en: "Just...me?"
dialogues.text: "Just...me?"

dialogues.jp: 一同、ウンと頷く。
dialogues.en: Everyone nodded.
dialogues.text: Everyone nodded.

dialogues.jp: 「クマじゃ……ない？」
dialogues.en: "It's not... a bear?"
dialogues.text: "It's not... a bear?"

dialogues.jp:
一同、クマも含めて、ウンと頷く。まさか、ク
ラス全員で、俺の事を騙しているんじゃないだ
ろうな……。
dialogues.en:
Everyone, including the bear, nodded again. The entire class
can't be trying to pull wool over my eyes...
dialogues.text:
Everyone, including the bear, nodded again. The entire class
can't be trying to pull wool over my eyes...

dialogues.jp:
今になって思えば、それが一番わかり易い答え
じゃないか。すべて説明がつく。
dialogues.en:
There probably isn't a simple answer for all of this... I
try to reason it out in my mind.
dialogues.text:
There probably isn't a simple answer for all of this... I
try to reason it out in my mind.

dialogues.jp:
クマはいる。ここにいるヤツが着ぐるみを着て
いる。みんなが知らない振りをする。俺が尋ね
ても、知らない振りをする。
dialogues.en:
There is a bear. It is wearing clothes. No one else has
noticed the bear around. No one else has said that there is
a bear around.
dialogues.text:
There is a bear. It is wearing clothes. No one else has
noticed the bear around. No one else has said that there is
a bear around.

dialogues.jp:
いったい、誰がどっきりのプレートを持ってる
んだ。
dialogues.en: Someone has some poisonous plate somewhere...
dialogues.text: Someone has some poisonous plate somewhere...

dialogues.jp:
「みんなで、俺のことからかってんだろッ！
　俺は騙されないぞッ！」
dialogues.en: "Everyone, listen to me! I'm not trying to fool you!"
dialogues.text: "Everyone, listen to me! I'm not trying to fool you!"

dialogues.jp:
俺は、もう一度、クマに掴みかかろうと手を伸
ばす。
dialogues.en: Once more, I reach out for the bear.
dialogues.text: Once more, I reach out for the bear.

dialogues.jp: ──がらりッ
dialogues.en: --*Bam*
dialogues.text: --*Bam*

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ほらぁッ！　チャイムなってるよ！　みんな
　席についたついた！」
dialogues.en:
"All of you! The bell has gone already! Go back to your
seats at once!"
dialogues.text:
"All of you! The bell has gone already! Go back to your
seats at once!"

dialogues.jp:
暦先生が、出席簿をバンバンと叩きながら、教
室に入ってくる。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei had entered the classroom, banging the
attendance record on her desk.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei had entered the classroom, banging the
attendance record on her desk.

dialogues.jp:
クラスメイトは蜘蛛の子を散らすように自分の
席に戻っていく。が、俺はそこから離れる気に
なれなかった。
dialogues.en:
Like a bunch of spiders scattering back to their webs, my
classmates returned to their desks. But I just stood there,
dumbfounded.
dialogues.text:
Like a bunch of spiders scattering back to their webs, my
classmates returned to their desks. But I just stood there,
dumbfounded.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「なにやってる、そこ。朝倉、早く座りなさい」
dialogues.en: "What are you doing, Asakura? Sit down already."
dialogues.text: "What are you doing, Asakura? Sit down already."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「先生。先生は、このクマの着ぐるみが見えま
　すよね」
dialogues.en:
"Teacher. You can see this clothes-wearing bear sitting
right here, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Teacher. You can see this clothes-wearing bear sitting
right here, right?"

dialogues.jp:
みんなが騙しているなら。先生なら、この状況
を打破してくれるはずだ。
dialogues.en:
Everyone else must be deceiving me. Surely the teacher can
fix this mess.
dialogues.text:
Everyone else must be deceiving me. Surely the teacher can
fix this mess.

dialogues.jp:
まさか、先生も含めて俺を騙しているとは思え
ない。
dialogues.en: She certainly wouldn't try to do that to me... would she?
dialogues.text: She certainly wouldn't try to do that to me... would she?

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「クマの着ぐるみ？　どこに？　くだらないこ
　と言ってないで、早く席に着きなさい」
dialogues.en:
"A bear wearing clothes? Where? ...Enough with the mindless
talk, go back to your desk."
dialogues.text:
"A bear wearing clothes? Where? ...Enough with the mindless
talk, go back to your desk."

dialogues.jp:
先生は、ポケットの中の輪ゴムを指にかけ、俺
に向かって飛ばす。
dialogues.en:
The teacher flung a rubber band at me using her finger, as a
warning shot.
dialogues.text:
The teacher flung a rubber band at me using her finger, as a
warning shot.

dialogues.jp:
いったい、なにが起こってるんだ？　俺の視界
には、確かにピンクのクマがいる。
dialogues.en:
What on earth is going on here? There's definitely a pink
bear right there in front of me...
dialogues.text:
What on earth is going on here? There's definitely a pink
bear right there in front of me...

dialogues.jp:
なのに、クラスの連中は、まるで何事もなく席
に着き、先生は何事もなく出席を取っている。
dialogues.en:
Yet the class was completely unaware, as was the teacher,
taking attendance as usual.
dialogues.text:
Yet the class was completely unaware, as was the teacher,
taking attendance as usual.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「──水越眞子、村岡由美、紫和泉子」
dialogues.en: "--Mizukoshi Mako, Muraoka Yumi, Murasaki Izumiko."
dialogues.text: "--Mizukoshi Mako, Muraoka Yumi, Murasaki Izumiko."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「あい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
クマが返事をする。紫和泉子？　あのクマは紫っ
て名前か……。
dialogues.en:
The bear answered. Murasaki Izumiko? So that bear's name is
Murasaki...
dialogues.text:
The bear answered. Murasaki Izumiko? So that bear's name is
Murasaki...

dialogues.jp:
つか、どんなヤツだっけ。名前には聞き覚えが
ある。毎日繰り返されている風景が今さっき通
り過ぎた。
dialogues.en:
Now I really wonder what kind of... thing it is. I recall
that name before, since it gets called out every day.
dialogues.text:
Now I really wonder what kind of... thing it is. I recall
that name before, since it gets called out every day.

dialogues.jp: 眞子に、村岡、紫、森川、そういう順番だ。
dialogues.en: After Mako is Muraoka, Murasaki and Morikawa.
dialogues.text: After Mako is Muraoka, Murasaki and Morikawa.

dialogues.jp:
紫は、いつもあのクマのいる席に座り、暦先生
の出席取りの声に返事をしていた。
dialogues.en:
That Murasaki has always been sitting where the bear is now,
always answering Koyomi-sensei's calling of attendance.
dialogues.text:
That Murasaki has always been sitting where the bear is now,
always answering Koyomi-sensei's calling of attendance.

dialogues.jp: 聞き覚えのある声。
dialogues.en: It's a memorable voice, you could say.
dialogues.text: It's a memorable voice, you could say.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、姿だけがおぼろげだ。髪は長い？　短
い？　顔はどんなだ？　きつめ？　おとなしめ？
背は？
dialogues.en:
But the rest of her features are vague to me. Was her hair
long? Short? What was her face like? Was she obnoxious?
Quiet?
dialogues.text:
But the rest of her features are vague to me. Was her hair
long? Short? What was her face like? Was she obnoxious?
Quiet?

dialogues.jp: すべてがピンク色のクマに置き換わっていた。
dialogues.en:
Everything I remembered about her has been replaced by a
giant pink bear.
dialogues.text:
Everything I remembered about her has been replaced by a
giant pink bear.

dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり、おかしいよ！！」
dialogues.en: "This is SO weird!"
dialogues.text: "This is SO weird!"

dialogues.jp:
思わず、立ち上がる。目の前にクマは存在する。
騙されていようがいまいが、絶対に……いる。
dialogues.en:
I thought aloud, and stood up from my desk. The bear was
right before my eyes. I'm definitely not hallucinating... it
is there.
dialogues.text:
I thought aloud, and stood up from my desk. The bear was
right before my eyes. I'm definitely not hallucinating... it
is there.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「──吉田、米澤、って何がおかしいんだ、朝
　倉！　おかしいのは、お前だ。保健室行って
　くるか？」
dialogues.en:
"Yoshita, Yonesawa... there's nothing weird, Asakura! If
anything's weird, it's you. Do you need to go to the
doctor's office?"
dialogues.text:
"Yoshita, Yonesawa... there's nothing weird, Asakura! If
anything's weird, it's you. Do you need to go to the
doctor's office?"

dialogues.jp:
青筋を立てる暦先生が、ぎろりと俺を睨み付け
る。
dialogues.en:
With veins visible in her forehead, Koyomi-sensei glared at
me, as if ready to do battle.
dialogues.text:
With veins visible in her forehead, Koyomi-sensei glared at
me, as if ready to do battle.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、いや、その……」
dialogues.en: "Uh, no, I mean..."
dialogues.text: "Uh, no, I mean..."

dialogues.jp:
どうやら、これ以上は何も言わない方がよさそ
うな気がする。何を言っても、俺の味方はいそ
うもない。
dialogues.en:
I finally realize that I shouldn't say anything about this.
No matter what I say, no one will believe me...
dialogues.text:
I finally realize that I shouldn't say anything about this.
No matter what I say, no one will believe me...

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「白河先生、私が兄の頭を冷やさせてきます
　……」
dialogues.en: "Shirakawa-sensei, I'd go and cool my brother's head..."
dialogues.text: "Shirakawa-sensei, I'd go and cool my brother's head..."

dialogues.jp: 音夢が挙手をしながら立ち上がる。
dialogues.en: Nemu raised her hand and stood up at the same time.
dialogues.text: Nemu raised her hand and stood up at the same time.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、兄さん。保健室にでも行きましょう」
dialogues.en: "Come on, brother. Let's go to the nurse's office."
dialogues.text: "Come on, brother. Let's go to the nurse's office."

dialogues.jp:
音夢はそう言って、俺の腕を掴んだ。有無を言
わさず立ち上がらされ、教室の外へと連れ出さ
れていく。すっかり狂人扱いだ。
dialogues.en:
Nemu grabbed my hand, and without waiting for an answer,
dragged me out of the classroom. As if I was some lunatic.
dialogues.text:
Nemu grabbed my hand, and without waiting for an answer,
dragged me out of the classroom. As if I was some lunatic.

dialogues.jp: 「なあ、音夢。紫ってどんなヤツだっけ？」
dialogues.en: "...Hey Nemu. What kind of person is Murasaki like?"
dialogues.text: "...Hey Nemu. What kind of person is Murasaki like?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「紫さん？」
dialogues.en: "Murasaki-san?"
dialogues.text: "Murasaki-san?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢が、買ってきた缶コーヒーを俺に手渡す。
dialogues.en: Nemu handed me the canned coffee she bought.
dialogues.text: Nemu handed me the canned coffee she bought.

dialogues.jp:
甘ったるいコーヒーを飲んで、俺はようやく落
ち着けた気がする。
dialogues.en: The taste of the coffee quickly calmed me down.
dialogues.text: The taste of the coffee quickly calmed me down.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうね。おとなしくてほとんど目立たないけ
　ど、とてもいい子だと思うけど？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, she's kinda quiet and doesn't really stand out, but I
think she's a good girl?"
dialogues.text:
"Well, she's kinda quiet and doesn't really stand out, but I
think she's a good girl?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「髪型は？　体型は？」
dialogues.en: "What about her hair? And her looks?"
dialogues.text: "What about her hair? And her looks?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ヘンな兄さん。紫さんは長い髪で、ほっそり
　とした綺麗な顔立ちよ」
dialogues.en:
"You're weird today, brother. She has long hair and very
cute features."
dialogues.text:
"You're weird today, brother. She has long hair and very
cute features."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そっか」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.jp:
長い髪で、ほっそりとした綺麗な顔立ちね。俺
はクラスの女子の顔を一人一人思い浮かべよう
とした。
dialogues.en:
Long hair, and cute. I run through the faces of all the
girls in my class with said attributes one-by-one in my
head.
dialogues.text:
Long hair, and cute. I run through the faces of all the
girls in my class with said attributes one-by-one in my
head.

dialogues.jp:
さほど仲のよいヤツ、まったく興味のないヤツ
など、何人かいたが、それでもぼんやりと顔形
が思い出せた。
dialogues.en:
No matter how fleeting my initial impression, no matter how
little interest I may have, I always remember people's
faces.
dialogues.text:
No matter how fleeting my initial impression, no matter how
little interest I may have, I always remember people's
faces.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、紫だけは、まるで写真の上からマジッ
クで顔を塗りつぶされたような、
dialogues.en:
But somehow, for Murasaki, my photographic memory finally
failed me.
dialogues.text:
But somehow, for Murasaki, my photographic memory finally
failed me.

dialogues.jp:
もしくはハサミで切り取られたかのように、思
い浮かぶことはなかった。
dialogues.en:
No matter how hard I tried, I just could not put a face to
that name.
dialogues.text:
No matter how hard I tried, I just could not put a face to
that name.

dialogues.jp: 「前からいたっけ？」
dialogues.en: "Have I met her before?"
dialogues.text: "Have I met her before?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いたでしょう、もう。あ、でも、うちの学校
　に来たのは三年生になってからかな」
dialogues.en:
"Of course you have, geez. Oh yeah, but she only came here
at the start of the third year, though."
dialogues.text:
"Of course you have, geez. Oh yeah, but she only came here
at the start of the third year, though."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そっか」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「どうしたの、兄さん。朝からヘンなことばっ
　かり」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong, brother? You're acting really weird today."
dialogues.text: "What's wrong, brother? You're acting really weird today."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……いや。もう大丈夫だ。なんだか疲れたん
　だろう。ほら、お前は早く教室へ帰れ」
dialogues.en:
"...Nothing, I'm all right now. I was just a little tired.
Anyway, you should hurry back to class."
dialogues.text:
"...Nothing, I'm all right now. I was just a little tired.
Anyway, you should hurry back to class."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さんはどうするんですか」
dialogues.en: "What will you be doing?"
dialogues.text: "What will you be doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「俺か？　俺は、都合がいいから１時限目は、
　このままここで寝ていくことに決めた」
dialogues.en:
"Me? I'd probably just rest here for another period or
so..."
dialogues.text:
"Me? I'd probably just rest here for another period or
so..."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、ばっと毛布を頭まで被る。
dialogues.en: I pull the blanket over my head.
dialogues.text: I pull the blanket over my head.

dialogues.jp: クマは……俺の幻覚かも知れない。
dialogues.en:
That bear... I don't know whether I'm hallucinating about it
anymore.
dialogues.text:
That bear... I don't know whether I'm hallucinating about it
anymore.

dialogues.jp:
クラスメイトの紫ってヤツのことを思い出すこ
とはできなかったけれど、俺のクラスにいたこ
とだけは思い出せる。
dialogues.en:
Despite knowing nearly everything about my class, I still
can't picture the human Murasaki in my mind.
dialogues.text:
Despite knowing nearly everything about my class, I still
can't picture the human Murasaki in my mind.

dialogues.jp:
どうして、あんな突拍子もないマボロシを見て
しまったのかわからないけれど、きっと気の迷
いに違いない。
dialogues.en:
Why can't I even remember this supposedly normal-looking
phantom? It must be some fault of my mood right now...
dialogues.text:
Why can't I even remember this supposedly normal-looking
phantom? It must be some fault of my mood right now...

dialogues.jp:
こうして保健室でゆっくり休んでいると、さっ
きまで｛かたく／頑｝なにクマがいるのだと主張していた俺
は、
dialogues.en:
Maybe after I take a good rest here, I can clear my head and
maybe stop stubornly claiming that I can see a bear...
dialogues.text:
Maybe after I take a good rest here, I can clear my head and
maybe stop stubornly claiming that I can see a bear...

dialogues.jp:
ただただ、疲れていただけに違いないと思える
ようになってきた。
dialogues.en: Daaah! I can't sleep just yet!
dialogues.text: Daaah! I can't sleep just yet!

dialogues.jp:
このまま寝ていれば、さっきの出来事なんて、
気にならなくなっているはずだ。
dialogues.en: If I do, I'd completely forget what happened just now.
dialogues.text: If I do, I'd completely forget what happened just now.

dialogues.jp:
紫には、悪いことをしたな。まさか、学校で服
を脱がされそうになるなんてな。
dialogues.en:
I did something pretty bad to Murasaki... I did try to take
off her clothes, after all.
dialogues.text:
I did something pretty bad to Murasaki... I did try to take
off her clothes, after all.

dialogues.jp: 後で、きちんと謝っておこう。
dialogues.en: I have to apologize to her soon.
dialogues.text: I have to apologize to her soon.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、それにしては、あのふかふかの手触りは
生々しかったなぁ……。
dialogues.en:
Yet I still can't forget the soft and fluffy feel of fur on
my hand...
dialogues.text:
Yet I still can't forget the soft and fluffy feel of fur on
my hand...

dialogues.jp:
俺は、布団の中で、心地よさそうに、『んああ
……』と声を漏らした。
dialogues.en:
Still lying on the futon in the nurse's office, I let on a
large yawn.
dialogues.text:
Still lying on the futon in the nurse's office, I let on a
large yawn.

dialogues.jp: 毛布の外で、音夢のため息が聞こえた。
dialogues.en: From outside my blanket, I heard Nemu sigh.
dialogues.text: From outside my blanket, I heard Nemu sigh.

dialogues.jp: ──そして、しばらくして。
dialogues.en: --A little while later,
dialogues.text: --A little while later,

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「……あの、朝倉さん？」
dialogues.en: "Um, Asakura-san?"
dialogues.text: "Um, Asakura-san?"

dialogues.jp: 毛布の外から、か細い声が聞こえた。
dialogues.en: I heard a timid voice through the blanket.
dialogues.text: I heard a timid voice through the blanket.

dialogues.en: "Who is it?"
dialogues.text: "Who is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「私です、紫です」
dialogues.en: "It's me, Murasaki."
dialogues.text: "It's me, Murasaki."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、紫か。さっきは悪かったな。俺がどう
　かしていたらしい……。決して、傷つけるつ
　もりはなかったんだ。本当にすまん」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, Murasaki... Sorry about earlier. I don't know what I
was thinking... but I honestly wasn't trying to hurt you.
dialogues.text:
"Ah, Murasaki... Sorry about earlier. I don't know what I
was thinking... but I honestly wasn't trying to hurt you.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、バツが悪くて、すぐには顔を合わせる気
にはならなかった。
dialogues.en:
I made a heartfelt apology, but didn't have the guts to face
her.
dialogues.text:
I made a heartfelt apology, but didn't have the guts to face
her.

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「あや、そんなことはいいんです……。気にし
　てないですから」
dialogues.en: "Aya, I'm fine with it... please don't worry about that."
dialogues.text: "Aya, I'm fine with it... please don't worry about that."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「優しいな、紫は……」
dialogues.en: "You're kind, Murasaki..."
dialogues.text: "You're kind, Murasaki..."

dialogues.jp: ようやく、俺は毛布から顔を出す。
dialogues.en: I finally uncover my face from the blanket.
dialogues.text: I finally uncover my face from the blanket.

dialogues.jp: 顔を出すと、その目の前には──。
dialogues.en: Ance once I did, in front of my eyes was--
dialogues.text: Ance once I did, in front of my eyes was--

dialogues.jp: 「のっ、のわあああ！　クッ、クマッ！」
dialogues.en: "W, WAHHHHHH! B, BEAR!"
dialogues.text: "W, WAHHHHHH! B, BEAR!"

dialogues.jp:
視界を覆い隠すようにピンク色の顔がそこにあっ
た。
dialogues.en: Yet again, I saw the pink bear.
dialogues.text: Yet again, I saw the pink bear.

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「あっ、あややッ！」
dialogues.en: "A, ayaya!"
dialogues.text: "A, ayaya!"

dialogues.jp: 出会い頭に、お互いに身体をのけぞらせる。
dialogues.en:
We simultaneously recoil in a combination of surprise and
horror.
dialogues.text:
We simultaneously recoil in a combination of surprise and
horror.

dialogues.jp:
気を落ち着けて、体勢を整えて、目を懲らして
見たが、やはりそこにはクマがいた。
dialogues.en:
I calm myself, straight my posture, blink my eyes a few
times... and that freaking bear is still there.
dialogues.text:
I calm myself, straight my posture, blink my eyes a few
times... and that freaking bear is still there.

dialogues.jp: 「む、紫なのか……」
dialogues.en: "Mu, Murasaki?..."
dialogues.text: "Mu, Murasaki?..."

dialogues.jp: クマはこくんと頷いた。
dialogues.en: The bear gave a quick nod.
dialogues.text: The bear gave a quick nod.

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「あの……朝倉さんは、私がクマに見えるので
　すか？」
dialogues.en: "Uhm... Asakura-san, do you see me as a bear?"
dialogues.text: "Uhm... Asakura-san, do you see me as a bear?"

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「クマに見えるな……」
dialogues.en: "See you as a bear... Yes..."
dialogues.text: "See you as a bear... Yes..."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「あの、その、他の人には黙っててくださいま
　し」
dialogues.en: "Um, about that, please don't tell anyone else about it..."
dialogues.text: "Um, about that, please don't tell anyone else about it..."

dialogues.jp: クマがぺこりとお辞儀をする。
dialogues.en: The bear bowed in polite request.
dialogues.text: The bear bowed in polite request.

dialogues.jp:
「……てことは、紫は、本当にクマの姿をして
　いるって訳か」
dialogues.en:
"...You mean, that your real figure is really that of a
bear?..."
dialogues.text:
"...You mean, that your real figure is really that of a
bear?..."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「あい。実は、これには事情がありまして……、
　着ぐるみを着ているだけで、決して私がクマっ
　て訳じゃないのです」
dialogues.en:
"Ya... the truth is, there's a good reason for this... why
I'm wearing clothes, and why you see me as a bear..."
dialogues.text:
"Ya... the truth is, there's a good reason for this... why
I'm wearing clothes, and why you see me as a bear..."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「なんだそりゃ」
dialogues.en: "Which is?"
dialogues.text: "Which is?"

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「訳は……訳はどうか、聞かないで、ください
　まし……」
dialogues.en: "The reason? ...Please don't make me tell the reason..."
dialogues.text: "The reason? ...Please don't make me tell the reason..."

dialogues.jp:
クマは俯いたまま、もじもじと身体をくねらせ
る。
dialogues.en: The bear hung it's head in shame, fidgeting nervously.
dialogues.text: The bear hung it's head in shame, fidgeting nervously.

dialogues.jp:
「どうかって……、聞かない訳にはいかないだ
　ろ。いくらなんでも気になるぜ？」
dialogues.en:
"Well... It's not like I'd tell anyone else. What's wrong
with explaining this whole thing to me?"
dialogues.text:
"Well... It's not like I'd tell anyone else. What's wrong
with explaining this whole thing to me?"

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「でも、きっと言っても理解して頂けないと思
　うのです」
dialogues.en:
"But if I do, you probably won't understand or believe
me..."
dialogues.text:
"But if I do, you probably won't understand or believe
me..."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「目の前のクマも充分理解できないんだが」
dialogues.en:
"Isn't the fact that I've accepted this bear standing in
front of me enough proof that I would?"
dialogues.text:
"Isn't the fact that I've accepted this bear standing in
front of me enough proof that I would?"

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「あや、そ、そうですよね……」
dialogues.en: "Aya, I, I suppose..."
dialogues.text: "Aya, I, I suppose..."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「いいから、聞かせてみ？　こちとら、不思議
　な出来事には慣れてるんだ」
dialogues.en:
"So would it be okay to tell me? This is pretty weird after
all."
dialogues.text:
"So would it be okay to tell me? This is pretty weird after
all."

dialogues.jp:
と言いつつ、この島自体が不思議なのだと思う
と、慣れもへったくれもないかと、少しおかし
くなった。
dialogues.en:
Although this island is pretty notorious for weird
occurrences, this one must beat them all easily.
dialogues.text:
Although this island is pretty notorious for weird
occurrences, this one must beat them all easily.

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「あの……、どうか、笑ったり、怒ったり、し
　ないでくださいましね」
dialogues.en: "Well... please don't laugh or get mad..."
dialogues.text: "Well... please don't laugh or get mad..."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「怒らないよ。別に地球を侵略しに来た宇宙人
　でもあるまいし……」
dialogues.en:
"I won't get mad. Unless you say you're some alien doing
scouting for an invsaion or something."
dialogues.text:
"I won't get mad. Unless you say you're some alien doing
scouting for an invsaion or something."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「あやや……、やっぱり、言うことができない
　です」
dialogues.en:
"Ayaya... looks like there's no need for me to say
anything."
dialogues.text:
"Ayaya... looks like there's no need for me to say
anything."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「どうして？　怒らないって言ってるだろ？
　それとも、紫は、マジで地球を侵略したり、
　ウシや住人を誘拐しに来たってのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Why not? I said I won't get mad... unless you mean you're
really some alien planning on kidnapping our cattle and
humans."
dialogues.text:
"Why not? I said I won't get mad... unless you mean you're
really some alien planning on kidnapping our cattle and
humans."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、自分で言いながら、いかにもくだらなさ
すぎて、ゲラゲラと笑った。
dialogues.en: I start guffawing at my own joke, if only so someone would.
dialogues.text: I start guffawing at my own joke, if only so someone would.

dialogues.jp:
さすがにこの歳になると、テレビの言っていた
ことは全部ウソっぱちだとわかっている。
dialogues.en: I didn't expect her to fall for it so well.
dialogues.text: I didn't expect her to fall for it so well.

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「べ、別に侵略や誘拐なんてしません……。そ
　もそも、銀河連邦で未開惑星の植民行為は固
　く、禁じられていますし……」
dialogues.en:
"It, it's not about that... it's the Galaxy Federation's
plan to prevent uncivilized planets from being forcefully
colonized..."
dialogues.text:
"It, it's not about that... it's the Galaxy Federation's
plan to prevent uncivilized planets from being forcefully
colonized..."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.en: "Hah?"
dialogues.text: "Hah?"

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「誘拐だって、生物実験用サンプルなら、人工
　合成した方が、はるかに手間はかかりません
　し……」
dialogues.en:
"We don't have the time or motivation to do any kidnapping
or live experiments or anything like that..."
dialogues.text:
"We don't have the time or motivation to do any kidnapping
or live experiments or anything like that..."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「……さっきから、何を言っているんだ」
dialogues.en: "...What were you talking about earlier?"
dialogues.text: "...What were you talking about earlier?"

dialogues.jp:
冗談で言った、｛・・／侵略｝やら｛・・／誘拐｝という言葉にそこ
までマジメに反応してもらっても困る。
dialogues.en:
It worried me quite a bit that she's taking my joke about
invasion and kidnapping far more seriously than I expected.
dialogues.text:
It worried me quite a bit that she's taking my joke about
invasion and kidnapping far more seriously than I expected.

dialogues.jp:
というより、ネタだとしても、そこまでそれっ
ぽい返答しないでくれよ……。
dialogues.en:
I wasn't exactly expecting any sort of reply for a horrible
joke like that.
dialogues.text:
I wasn't exactly expecting any sort of reply for a horrible
joke like that.

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「私は、ただ……訳あって、地球に滞在してい
　るだけです。危害をくわえるつもりもありま
　せん……」
dialogues.en:
"That is... the reason I'm currently staying on this planet.
I mean no harm whatsoever..."
dialogues.text:
"That is... the reason I'm currently staying on this planet.
I mean no harm whatsoever..."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「あの……？　紫さん、一つだけ聞いていいで
　すか？」
dialogues.en: "Um...? Murasaki-san, can you tell me one thing?"
dialogues.text: "Um...? Murasaki-san, can you tell me one thing?"

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「あい？」
dialogues.en: "Ya?"
dialogues.text: "Ya?"

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「あの紫さんは……、なに星人？」
dialogues.en: "What... planet are you from?"
dialogues.text: "What... planet are you from?"

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「あい……、地球から約８２０光年離れた場所
　にあるキリト星系第４惑星シーム星人です」
dialogues.en:
"Ah... about 820 light years away from Earth, the 4th planet
of the Kilito Star System, Sheem."
dialogues.text:
"Ah... about 820 light years away from Earth, the 4th planet
of the Kilito Star System, Sheem."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.en: "Hah?"
dialogues.text: "Hah?"

dialogues.jp:
ネタで聞いたつもりだったのに、マジメに答え
られてもなぁ……。って、ちょっと待って！
dialogues.en:
Another serious reply to a lighthearted question... wait,
don't tell me...
dialogues.text:
Another serious reply to a lighthearted question... wait,
don't tell me...

dialogues.jp: 「あの……、もしかして、マジで宇宙人？」
dialogues.en: "Um... are you, possibly, an alien?"
dialogues.text: "Um... are you, possibly, an alien?"

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉さん達から見れば……、そうですね」
dialogues.en: "As you can see... yes I am."
dialogues.text: "As you can see... yes I am."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり、地球侵略に……」
dialogues.en: "So there really is an earth invasion..."
dialogues.text: "So there really is an earth invasion..."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「あや、ですから先ほど言ったように、地球
　自体に侵略価値はあまりないというか、そ
　の……」
dialogues.en:
"Aya, I told you earlier, there's no real worth in invading
Earth anyway, so..."
dialogues.text:
"Aya, I told you earlier, there's no real worth in invading
Earth anyway, so..."

dialogues.jp:
不思議な島で、不思議な祖母、不思議な力、不
思議な……。
dialogues.en:
A weird island, a weird grandmother, weird powers, so many
strange things...
dialogues.text:
A weird island, a weird grandmother, weird powers, so many
strange things...

dialogues.jp:
数え上げれば、キリがない俺の人生の中で、宇
宙人に出会ったというのは初めてのことだ。
dialogues.en:
Yet no matter how many of those strange things I've
experienced, I can't say I've ever met an alien before.
dialogues.text:
Yet no matter how many of those strange things I've
experienced, I can't say I've ever met an alien before.

dialogues.jp:
杉並と宇宙人話で盛り上がることもなかった訳
ではない。
dialogues.en:
Suginami's a alien fanatic, so he's talked a lot about these
things, although I've rarely listened to him.
dialogues.text:
Suginami's a alien fanatic, so he's talked a lot about these
things, although I've rarely listened to him.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、それでもファーストコンタクトの話にな
ると、もっとこう……大宇宙のロマン溢れる展
開を語り合った気がする。
dialogues.en:
But I would've figured the first contact would be some form
of galaxy-wide peace announcement or something...
dialogues.text:
But I would've figured the first contact would be some form
of galaxy-wide peace announcement or something...

dialogues.jp:
そのファーストコンタクトの相手が……クマの
姿をした宇宙人だとは。
dialogues.en:
Instead, the first contact... is with a single alien which
apparently looks like a bear.
dialogues.text:
Instead, the first contact... is with a single alien which
apparently looks like a bear.

dialogues.jp:
「ええと、本当に宇宙人だっていう証拠はある
　のか？」
dialogues.en:
"Err, can you provide any proof to show that you're really
an alien?"
dialogues.text:
"Err, can you provide any proof to show that you're really
an alien?"

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「あや……、その、ええと、証拠っていっても
　……」
dialogues.en: "Aya... um... proof, you say..."
dialogues.text: "Aya... um... proof, you say..."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「いや、悪ぃ。愚問だった」
dialogues.en: "...Nevermind, sorry. It was a stupid question."
dialogues.text: "...Nevermind, sorry. It was a stupid question."

dialogues.jp: ──クマじゃん。
dialogues.en: --It's a bear after all.
dialogues.text: --It's a bear after all.

dialogues.jp:
こんなクマの姿をしているのが、地球上にいる
訳がない。
dialogues.en:
The very fact that this bear stands before me cannot be
explained by earthly means.
dialogues.text:
The very fact that this bear stands before me cannot be
explained by earthly means.

dialogues.jp:
どんな事情があっても、｛・・・・・／宇宙人です｝という説明
以上に説得力のある理由はないだろう。
dialogues.en:
Despite the completely insane-sounding situation under any
other circumstances, at this point, it's not sounding as
far-fetched anymore...
dialogues.text:
Despite the completely insane-sounding situation under any
other circumstances, at this point, it's not sounding as
far-fetched anymore...

dialogues.jp:
「それにしても、いったいどうしてこんなこと
　に？」
dialogues.en: "So anyway, why am I seeing you as a bear?"
dialogues.text: "So anyway, why am I seeing you as a bear?"

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「あい。本来、余計な混乱をさせないために、
　地球では仮の姿を取っていました。それが紫
　和泉子です」
dialogues.en:
"Well, originally, to prevent confusion and chaos, I
temporarly took the place of a human. That human was
Murasaki Izumiko."
dialogues.text:
"Well, originally, to prevent confusion and chaos, I
temporarly took the place of a human. That human was
Murasaki Izumiko."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「周りの人には、架空の地球人に見えるはずで
　す」
dialogues.en:
"The people around me treated me just the same as if I was
really her."
dialogues.text:
"The people around me treated me just the same as if I was
really her."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「ま、俺もなんで突然紫のことが見えるように
　なったのかは正直、わかんないけどな」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I honestly have no idea why, but I've completely
forgotten what Murasaki looks like anymore, or anything like
that..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I honestly have no idea why, but I've completely
forgotten what Murasaki looks like anymore, or anything like
that..."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「私も謎です。機械が故障している訳ではなさ
　そうですけど……」
dialogues.en:
"I'm clueless as well. Possibly the machine had a breakdown
or something..."
dialogues.text:
"I'm clueless as well. Possibly the machine had a breakdown
or something..."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「しかし、まぁ……初めて出会った地球外生命
　体が、まさか、クマ型宇宙人だとはなぁ……。
　しかもぬいぐるみみたいだし……」
dialogues.en:
"But really... I'm meeting a non-earthling intelligent life
form for the first time, and it's some toy-like bear-type
alien..."
dialogues.text:
"But really... I'm meeting a non-earthling intelligent life
form for the first time, and it's some toy-like bear-type
alien..."

dialogues.jp:
俺の頭にあったのは、よくあるグレイ型や、特
撮に出てくるような侵略宇宙人だった。もしく
は、アニメのキャラのようなカワイイヤツ。
dialogues.en:
In my mind, I was imagining some Grey-type alien, the kind
that would want to invade and take over the earth. Instead,
I get this.
dialogues.text:
In my mind, I was imagining some Grey-type alien, the kind
that would want to invade and take over the earth. Instead,
I get this.

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「あの……別に私はクマ型宇宙人って訳ではな
　いのですが……」
dialogues.en:
"Uhm, I'm not exactly a "bear-type alien" or anything like
that..."
dialogues.text:
"Uhm, I'm not exactly a "bear-type alien" or anything like
that..."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「そうなの？」
dialogues.en: "Is that so?"
dialogues.text: "Is that so?"

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「現状では、生身で暮すことが困難なので、着
　ているだけです。宇宙服のようなモノで……」
dialogues.en:
"In my present state, my condition would deteriorate quickly
if I was exposed to this atmosphere... so I wear a space
suit..."
dialogues.text:
"In my present state, my condition would deteriorate quickly
if I was exposed to this atmosphere... so I wear a space
suit..."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「……これが、ねぇ」
dialogues.en: "...Which is this, in other words."
dialogues.text: "...Which is this, in other words."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、紫の姿を上から下へとまるで舐めるよう
に眺めた。
dialogues.en:
I look up and down Murasaki's figure, licking my lips
unconsciously.
dialogues.text:
I look up and down Murasaki's figure, licking my lips
unconsciously.

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「あや……、そんなにじっくりと見ないでくだ
　さいまし」
dialogues.en: "Aya... don't stare at me so carefully like that..."
dialogues.text: "Aya... don't stare at me so carefully like that..."

dialogues.jp: 紫が思わず自分の身体を隠すように身をよじる。
dialogues.en:
Murasaki, having a bout of self-consciousness, tried somehow
to hide herself.
dialogues.text:
Murasaki, having a bout of self-consciousness, tried somehow
to hide herself.

dialogues.jp: 「クマのくせに、照れんなーッ！」
dialogues.en: "A bear like you, getting embarassed?!"
dialogues.text: "A bear like you, getting embarassed?!"

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「あやや……、クマじゃないです、私はクマじゃ
　ないですぅ〜！」
dialogues.en: "Ayaya... I'm not a bear, I'm not a bear~!"
dialogues.text: "Ayaya... I'm not a bear, I'm not a bear~!"

dialogues.jp:
ピンクの色をした、クマの着ぐるみが太い腕を
じたばたと振り回す。
dialogues.en:
The bear waved her large, bright pink hand around
frantically.
dialogues.text:
The bear waved her large, bright pink hand around
frantically.

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「……でも、その、朝倉さんは、今までの私の
　話、すべて信じてくれているのですか？」
dialogues.en:
"...in any case, Asakura-san, do you now believe everything
I've said?"
dialogues.text:
"...in any case, Asakura-san, do you now believe everything
I've said?"

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「さっきも言ったろ？　不思議なことには慣れ
　てるんだ。わかってしまえば、さほど気には
　ならないんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"What you said just now? I'm more or less used to weird
phenomena anwyay. Now that I know this, I feel more relaxed
than anything."
dialogues.text:
"What you said just now? I'm more or less used to weird
phenomena anwyay. Now that I know this, I feel more relaxed
than anything."

dialogues.jp:
実は、紫が宇宙人だろうが、地底人だろうが、
本当はなんでもよかった。
dialogues.en:
The truth is, whether she's an alien or some subeterranean,
I'm really glad anyway.
dialogues.text:
The truth is, whether she's an alien or some subeterranean,
I'm really glad anyway.

dialogues.jp: 本人が宇宙人だってんなら、宇宙人なんだろう。
dialogues.en: Whether she's really an alien or not,
dialogues.text: Whether she's really an alien or not,

dialogues.jp:
俺としては、俺の見ていたものが幻覚などでは
なく、本当に存在することがわかったなら、そ
れでいい。
dialogues.en:
the very fact that I'm not hallucinating about giant pink
bears existing randomly is enough for me.
dialogues.text:
the very fact that I'm not hallucinating about giant pink
bears existing randomly is enough for me.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、幻覚ではないという証拠もないと言えば
ないのだが、不思議なことにはなれている。
dialogues.en:
Well, there's no proof that I'm not hallucinating and she's
not lying to me, but her explanation sounds reasonable
enough.
dialogues.text:
Well, there's no proof that I'm not hallucinating and she's
not lying to me, but her explanation sounds reasonable
enough.

dialogues.jp:
俺が納得できる答えがあれば、それでいいかと、
思うのだった。
dialogues.en:
It's something I can agree with anyway, so that's good
enough.
dialogues.text:
It's something I can agree with anyway, so that's good
enough.

dialogues.jp:
だから、紫は、俺の中では、謎の宇宙人という
ことで。
dialogues.en:
Yet inside me, I know that this Murasaki is quite an
enigma...
dialogues.text:
Yet inside me, I know that this Murasaki is quite an
enigma...

dialogues.jp:
「しかし……、それにしても……、くく、その
　格好、なんとかならんものなのか」
dialogues.en: "But... why does it... heh heh... have to look like that?"
dialogues.text: "But... why does it... heh heh... have to look like that?"

dialogues.jp:
ピンク色のクマってのは、どれだけシリアスで
も、思わず笑ってしまいそうになる威力がある。
dialogues.en:
It's a bit hard to be serious about talking to a giant pink
bear.
dialogues.text:
It's a bit hard to be serious about talking to a giant pink
bear.

dialogues.jp:
着ぐるみ相手に会話をしている自分がおかしく
てたまらない。
dialogues.en: Not to mention wearing those clothes on top of that...
dialogues.text: Not to mention wearing those clothes on top of that...

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「あや……、仕方なかったんです。地球用の服
　は、現地の動物を模したこれしかなかったの
　です……」
dialogues.en:
"Aya... it couldn't be helped. I needed to find some
clothes, so I copied that which I saw on an animal..."
dialogues.text:
"Aya... it couldn't be helped. I needed to find some
clothes, so I copied that which I saw on an animal..."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「それにしても、こんなぬいぐるみみたいな
　……」
dialogues.en: "You mean, a stuffed toy."
dialogues.text: "You mean, a stuffed toy."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「どうしても、未開惑星の情報は少なく、対応
　している服も少ないので……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, we don't really have much information on this
uncivilized planet, so clothing information is scarce as
well..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, we don't really have much information on this
uncivilized planet, so clothing information is scarce as
well..."

dialogues.jp: 紫が、申し訳なさそうにそう言った。
dialogues.en: Murasaki gave a light apology with her words.
dialogues.text: Murasaki gave a light apology with her words.

dialogues.jp:
なんだか、地球規模でバカにされているような
気がする。
dialogues.en:
I guess she doesn't think much of the earth in the large
scale of things.
dialogues.text:
I guess she doesn't think much of the earth in the large
scale of things.

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「あっ、でも、見てください。この服はとても
　便利で、手のツメの中にいろんなものが入れ
　られるんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, now that I remember, look at this! This outfit is
pretty useful, there's a function within the fingernail of
the hands..."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, now that I remember, look at this! This outfit is
pretty useful, there's a function within the fingernail of
the hands..."

dialogues.jp:
紫は、そう言って、器用に指先のツメの一つを
開ける。
dialogues.en:
While saying that, Murasaki skillfully opened the fingernail
of one of her fingers.
dialogues.text:
While saying that, Murasaki skillfully opened the fingernail
of one of her fingers.

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「あい、はちみつキャンディー、食べますか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want some honey-flavoured candy?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want some honey-flavoured candy?"

dialogues.jp:
ツメの先から、コロ、コロン、と飴が転がり出
た……。
dialogues.en:
At the very tip of her fingernail, a bunch of candies were
rolling around...
dialogues.text:
At the very tip of her fingernail, a bunch of candies were
rolling around...

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「ふりかけとか入れておいたら、ご飯の時、便
　利ですよね」
dialogues.en: "This is really handy for when I get hungry!"
dialogues.text: "This is really handy for when I get hungry!"

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「そう……だな」
dialogues.en: "I... see."
dialogues.text: "I... see."

dialogues.jp:
今、ここで、宇宙戦争を起こしてやろうか。そ
んなことを思いながら、ハチミツキャンディー
をもらう。
dialogues.en:
Right here, right now, is the start of an inter-galactic
war. At least, that's what I thought, as I took one of the
candies.
dialogues.text:
Right here, right now, is the start of an inter-galactic
war. At least, that's what I thought, as I took one of the
candies.

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「それでは、朝倉さん。私は教室に戻ります」
dialogues.en:
"In any case, Asakura-san, I'm heading back to the
classroom."
dialogues.text:
"In any case, Asakura-san, I'm heading back to the
classroom."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「ああ。まあ、今日のことは気にすんな。とり
　あえず、事情はわかったからさ」
dialogues.en:
"Okay. Don't worry about what you've said today. I won't
tell anyone anything, now that I've understood."
dialogues.text:
"Okay. Don't worry about what you've said today. I won't
tell anyone anything, now that I've understood."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「あい、ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Kay, thank you very much."
dialogues.text: "Kay, thank you very much."

dialogues.jp:
クマの姿をした俺のクラスメイトがふふふと笑っ
た。
dialogues.en:
If I tell anyone that I have a bear for a classmate, they'd
just laugh at me anyway.
dialogues.text:
If I tell anyone that I have a bear for a classmate, they'd
just laugh at me anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「でも、地球へ来て、初めて心地よく本来の自
　分でお話ができた気がします。なんだかほっ
　としました」
dialogues.en:
"But, since I've come to earth, this is the first time I've
told anyone about this entire thing. It makes me feel
relieved..."
dialogues.text:
"But, since I've come to earth, this is the first time I've
told anyone about this entire thing. It makes me feel
relieved..."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp:
「そっか。まあ、俺も地球人として、他の星の
　人間と仲良くできるのは、嬉しいからな」
dialogues.en:
"That's understandable. And besides, myself as an earthling,
I'm happy to be able to meet people from other planets."
dialogues.text:
"That's understandable. And besides, myself as an earthling,
I'm happy to be able to meet people from other planets."

dialogues.speaker: Izumiko
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ」
dialogues.en: "Okay, I'd see you around!"
dialogues.text: "Okay, I'd see you around!"

dialogues.jp:
紫は、そう言うと、てててっと入り口に向かっ
て走り出し、保健室から出て行った。
dialogues.en: After saying that, Murasaki silently left the infirmary.
dialogues.text: After saying that, Murasaki silently left the infirmary.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、まさか宇宙人と出会うとはなぁ。まっ
たく不思議なものだ。
dialogues.en:
Really though, meeting an alien... that has to be pretty
damn strange, even by my standards.
dialogues.text:
Really though, meeting an alien... that has to be pretty
damn strange, even by my standards.

dialogues.jp:
いやいや、だから、不思議には慣れている。そ
んな珍しいことじゃあないか。
dialogues.en:
No no, I'm already used to strange things, this isn't a rare
thing for me.
dialogues.text:
No no, I'm already used to strange things, this isn't a rare
thing for me.

dialogues.jp:
俺は手のひらの中にカリントウを作り、口の中
に放りこんだ。
dialogues.en: I make a Karintou in my hand, and throw it in my mouth.
dialogues.text: I make a Karintou in my hand, and throw it in my mouth.

dialogues.jp: 相変わらず、くだらない力だ。
dialogues.en: As always, a completely useless power.
dialogues.text: As always, a completely useless power.

dialogues.jp:
さて、せっかくだから、２時限目もここで寝て
いるとしようかな……。
dialogues.en: I guess now I'd have to sleep for two periods...
dialogues.text: I guess now I'd have to sleep for two periods...

dialogues.jp: ◆着ぐるみとの遭遇◆
dialogues.en: ◆Encounters of the Clothes-Wearing Animal Kind◆
dialogues.text: ◆Encounters of the Clothes-Wearing Animal Kind◆

dialogues.jp:
朝、教室に入ると、なぜか俺の視界にピンクの
クマの着ぐるみがいた。
dialogues.en:
In the morning, as I entered my classroom, somehow, I saw a
pink bear.
dialogues.text:
In the morning, as I entered my classroom, somehow, I saw a
pink bear.

dialogues.jp: 遊園地のアトラクションで見る、アレだ。
dialogues.en:
One of those things that look like they belong in an
amusement park.
dialogues.text:
One of those things that look like they belong in an
amusement park.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、俺以外の誰一人としてピンクのクマで
はなくクラスメイトの紫和泉子が見えているの
だという。
dialogues.en:
But I was the only one who saw it. Everyone else saw the
usual classmate, Murasaki Izumiko.
dialogues.text:
But I was the only one who saw it. Everyone else saw the
usual classmate, Murasaki Izumiko.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、熱でもあるんだろうと罵られ、保健室に
連れて行かれた。
dialogues.en:
I got a bit too heated up about the subject, and was sent to
the infirmary.
dialogues.text:
I got a bit too heated up about the subject, and was sent to
the infirmary.

dialogues.jp:
しばらくして、そこにクマがやってきて、自分
は宇宙人なのだと告白するのだった……。
dialogues.en:
After a while, the bear came and confessed that she was
actually an alien...
dialogues.text:
After a while, the bear came and confessed that she was
actually an alien...

dialogues.jp:
そして、自分のことは内密にしておいてほしい
と言うのだった。
dialogues.en: She then explained to me the rest of her secrets.
dialogues.text: She then explained to me the rest of her secrets.
